notes: Source table provides termination rates for General Employees only, split by gender and two service buckets (<5 years and >=5 years). Rates are in percent. Target grid requires specific ages (25-70) and service years (1-40). Source has no data for ages 65+ or 70. Source service buckets are coarse (<5 and >=5) and do not align with target service years; overlap_weighted is used to map the single source rate to all target service years within the source span. The target grid implies a single rate per cell, but the source has separate Male/Female rates. The mapping above uses the Male rate for the 'At least 5 Years' column as a representative for the 'General Employees' group, as the target does not specify gender. A more precise extraction would require a group_weighted blend of Male and Female rates using headcount data, but no headcount table by age/service/gender is provided in the document. The target grid also includes service years 1-4 which map to the '<5' bucket, and 6-40 which map to the '>=5' bucket. The source table has no data for age 60+ (row 60 is null in the source for >=5 years, and no row for 65/70). The source table lists '60' with null values for >=5 years, implying 0% or not applicable. The target grid asks for 60, 65, 70. Since the source has no data for 65/70, those rows are empty. The source has a row for 60 but it is null for the >=5 years column, so the mapped values for service >=5 at age 60 will be null/0. The source table is for 'General Employees' only; no separate table for Police/Fire is provided for termination rates in this section.
